The *Buddhapūjanapañha* ("Adoration of Relics") is a dialogue in the *Milindapañha* (Mil 5.3.7) [SuttaCentral]. The text deals with the question of the veneration of the Buddha and his bodily relics, a topic directly linked to the canonical account of the Buddha's cremation and instructions on relic worship found in the *Mahāparinibbāna Sutta* (DN 16), as well as a cross-reference in Mil 7.7.2 (*Thanassitadārakaṅgapañha*) [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral records three modern translations of the text in three languages [SuttaCentral]. No secondary literature discussing this section was returned in the research dossier.
